ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the current state of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the efforts of the DHS to combat it.
questions: What are the current challenges facing the Minnesota DHS in combating Medicaid fraud?
How effective is the current screening process in detecting and preventing fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant weaknesses in the system and highlight the need for improved fraud detection and prevention measures.
